dimensions.assessment: Affects wildland firefighters performing prescribed burns and smokejumpers performing parachute jumps.
dimensions.evidence: duties involving the ignition, control, or suppression of a prescribed burn and duties involving parachute jumps... are duties involving unusual physical hardship or hazard

dimensions.assessment: Grants hazard pay equal to the pay differential for fighting forest and range fires on the fireline.
dimensions.evidence: pay differential under that subsection shall be equal to the pay differential for fighting forest and range fires on the fireline

dimensions.assessment: Increases compensation for specific firefighting duties, though exact aggregate cost figures are not provided.
dimensions.evidence: provide hazard pay for carrying out prescribed burns, and for other purposes

dimensions.assessment: Amends section 5545 of title 5, United States Code, and requires OPM regulations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5545 of title 5, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to federal firefighter compensation rules.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall apply with respect to pay periods beginning after the earlier of [the OPM regulation date or 90 days]

missing_information: Total number of federal employees affected and total budgetary cost of the hazard pay change.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides federal hazard pay for wildland firefighters carrying out prescribed burns and smokejumper parachute jumps, and mandates OPM regulations.
